I will do it the way I know, with small changes only. I have seen some neighbors get better maize when they plant bought seed and put a little fertilizer, so I will do that on this plot, but I will not put too much because money must also cover my other land. I will use some manure where I can, I will wait for rain and not irrigate, and I will not buy spray this season. My family will work most of the season, and I will hire people for some heavy work like weeding and harvest.
